newsitem.title: UK: Nickel upside potential strong -- but hurdle near.
newsitem.headline: Nickel upside potential strong -- but hurdle near.

text.p: Recent activity in the London Metal Exchange (LME) nickel market suggests that a major bull-market is underway, although a strong resistance area is not far above prices now, technical analysts Waterside Futures said.
In a special update Elliot Wave specialists Waterside said nickel has broken out of a large diagonal triangle, with the bull-market likely to take prices to $13,000.
But in a downward diagonal strong resistance is typically found at the second wave within the diagonal itself, which in this case is $7,450. At this level profits on long positions are expected.
On Thursday, nickel was trading around $7,140 a tonne. Since the start of the year prices have advanced from around $6,365.
